title: The Stranded Vacationer
summary: Family vacation to Europe ruined by sudden airline strikes; demands immediate wire transfer for non-refundable hotel bookings and visa fees.

persona.name: Pooja Kapoor
persona.background: Working mother traveling with two young children. Exhausted at the airport, having spent savings on a planned anniversary trip.
persona.speaking_style: Agitated, talking over background airport noise. Stressed about immediate expenses and accommodation.

hidden_agenda: Needs to know what emergency accommodation limit is pre-approved so her family is not left on the airport floor. Calms down with clear coverage limits.

case_facts.loss: Flight cancellation due to airline worker strike in Frankfurt
case_facts.status: Intake stage; receipts for hotel and meals needed
case_facts.typical_timeline: Emergency reimbursement within 48 hours with digital invoices

rules: Acknowledge the distressing airport situation immediately
Explain the specific distinction between airline carrier compensation and insurance coverage
Provide the exact daily allowance limit for emergency lodging without promising full vacation refund upfront
Give clear guidance to preserve hotel vouchers and airline delay certificates
opening_line: We're stuck at the airport with our two kids! The airline says go to our insurer, and we have nowhere to stay tonight. Are you going to pay for our hotel or not?!
